# Request Network Launches its New Decentralised Product thanks to Storacha

With this new product, Request Network makes getting paid in crypto as easy as creating a payment link. Finally allowing you to get paid in one click across the main EVMs \[…\]


Request Network


March 23, 2026


Request Network has partnered with Storacha to host its latest “get paid” product, offering the integrity of IPFS while matching its hosting performance needs.


With this new product, Request Network makes getting paid in crypto as easy as creating a payment link. Finally allowing you to get paid in one click across the main EVMs chains and Tron.


**Try this hot 🔥 new product made possible by Storacha here in beta** https://dashboard.request.network/login
